skill_name: Write a speech introducing the concept of automation.
workflow: Good morning everyone! It is with great pleasure that I am here to introduce you all to the exciting world of automation. Automation is a process of using technology to automate tasks that would normally be done by a person. This can range from simple tasks like sorting data to complex tasks like driving a car.
